cultural.vision_reason: This is a fired-clay figurine of three men (wearing striped robes and Uzbek-style skullcaps/tubeteikas) with a horse, a well-known Uzbek folk-craft souvenir type — the figures wear traditional Uzbek dress, so while the category "garment" is a mismatch, the object still belongs to Uzbek material culture as depicted clothing on a sculptural figurine.

physical.title: figurine
physical.summary: Figurine; made of fired clay; in the form of three men and horse; two men stand on either side of horse, third man rides on back; horse's mane and tail painted brown, reins black; man on left hat brown with white trim, eyebrows and moustache brown, robe blue with white and yellow stripes, man on right hat brown with white trim, eyebrows, moustache and beard white, robe brown with black and white stripes, man on horse hat brown with white trim, robe green with yellow dots, brown beard and boots; white square with line through it painted on bottom.
